treatment.logline: Inside a rain-bound cash van, a personal recording gives way to a work directive; Dinu's glance at a wrist thread precedes a change of route without explaining his allegiance.

arc.beat: Work encloses him; a worn image opens a private association.
The recording lands, then incoming contact interrupts the private space.
A destination is imposed; a private glance precedes compliance.

treatment.approach: A 90-second source bin of fifteen essential shots, using tight handheld interior coverage and sustained reactions rather than additional events. Recorded and live voices remain offscreen. The intended assembly expands the brief actions with real-time driving and listening holds, never repeating a directive or the route change. No exterior establishing footage or decorative inserts.

treatment.geography: All views remain inside the van. Dinu sits in the driver's seat; the camera stays on the passenger side or rear-centre, preserving forward travel. His left hand controls the wheel and bears the red thread; his right hand holds the phone low near his lap. The faded photo remains on the dashboard. Wet light and indistinct roadside structures establish Colombo without identifiable background performers.
treatment.key_image: The red thread above the wheel, followed by the forward view bending toward industrial structures.
advice: Keep the full L3 recording and L5 live audio intact and use each only once.
Coverage is planned for the large difference between the script clock and the 90-second target: let driving, listening and aftermath occupy the additional time.
The dashboard photograph contains faded, unresolvable figures; establish its village-bus-stop association without portraying an offscreen performer.
No musical elevation, slow motion or impact cutting.

moments.cut_uses: Wrist-and-wheel detail for the thread, face single for the held downward glance and return forward, rear-centre master for the turn and continuing industrial approach. Assemble as one glance and one turn.

editor_notes: The 90-second bin contains 15 must sources, not a locked 90-second assembly. Handles are inside those takes; a non-repeating cut may run shorter, so time the holds against the broadcaster's duration requirement without looping actions or lines.

The driving masters establish and preserve the forward axis; the tight singles and reactions carry the listening and its aftermath. The dashboard photo, incoming phone and wrist details are essential story details rather than decorative coverage.

L3 and L5 are heard-only, complete and used once each; add their original audio in post to the silent generated sources. Add rain, engine, playback onset and incoming tone separately. No dialogue is generated on screen.
Use the incoming phone detail to establish the change of contact; composite a legible caller ID if necessary. Bridge to the live audio without inventing an answering gesture.
Keep the faded photograph static and its printed figures unresolvable. It establishes the village bus-stop association without showing an offscreen performer.

The phone remains in Dinu's right hand near his lap, the red thread on his left wrist, and his left hand on the wheel. These placements and the plain charcoal work shirt were unspecified and chosen for continuity.

In the final sequence, cut from the stationary thread detail to one downward glance and return, then to one steering turn. Match wrist position and road direction carefully; do not replay either action.

Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options, not generated camera moves; the held sources are clean if editorial needs them. The intended scene does not require any of them.
No slow motion, mirrors, close body contact, sharply resolved crowds, added voices, extra story events or fabricated phone gestures were planned.

editor_notes: The 90-second bin contains 15 must sources, not a locked 90-second assembly. Handles are inside those takes; a non-repeating cut may run shorter, so time the holds against the broadcaster's duration requirement without looping actions or lines.

The driving masters establish and preserve the forward axis; the tight singles and reactions carry the listening and its aftermath. The dashboard photo, incoming phone and wrist details are essential story details rather than decorative coverage.

L3 and L5 are heard-only, complete and used once each; add their original audio in post to the silent generated sources. Add rain, engine, playback onset and incoming tone separately. No dialogue is generated on screen.
Use the incoming phone detail to establish the change of contact; composite a legible caller ID if necessary. Bridge to the live audio without inventing an answering gesture.
Keep the faded photograph static and its printed figures unresolvable. It establishes the village bus-stop association without showing an offscreen performer.

The phone remains in Dinu's right hand near his lap, the red thread on his left wrist, and his left hand on the wheel. These placements and the plain charcoal work shirt were unspecified and chosen for continuity.

In the final sequence, cut from the stationary thread detail to one downward glance and return, then to one steering turn. Match wrist position and road direction carefully; do not replay either action.

Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options, not generated camera moves; the held sources are clean if editorial needs them. The intended scene does not require any of them.
No slow motion, mirrors, close body contact, sharply resolved crowds, added voices, extra story events or fabricated phone gestures were planned.
blend_notes: c16: Close moment 7 after c15 completes the turn, over c15's continuing engine, tire and rain ambience; do not repeat the turn.
c17: Cut into c12's silent interval after L5 and back, over c12's cabin ambience; retain the phone low in Dinu's right hand.
c18: Use selected portions under the single continuous L3 recording from c07, with c07's cabin bed; never replay the line.

review.why: The three locked interior views already establish the enclosed wet journey; an exterior or texture insert would contradict the treatment or repeat coverage.
The locked photograph detail and profile association already deliver the private-history beat without illustration.
The master and playback audio establish the recording without inventing a device interaction or adding decorative material.
A foreground-framed listener reaction offers an isolated cabin view under L3 without repeating the recording.
The locked incoming-contact phone detail and face reaction already cover the interruption; another phone insert would repeat them.
A low-held phone and grip detail gives the silent interval after L5 physical pressure without an answering gesture.
An interior forward POV sustains the industrial approach after the one completed turn, without repeating the glance or steering action.
